package fixture

import "testing"

// Green fixture: mentions of the setting that do not set it for a session.
// SET session_replication_role = replica (in a comment)
func TestOnlyMentions(t *testing.T) {
	_ = db.Exec("RESET session_replication_role")
	_ = render("postgresql.settings.session_replication_role=replica")
	_ = db.Exec("ALTER TABLE t DISABLE TRIGGER x")
}
